cases.title: New learner opening on a busy comp

rubric.reason: judge failed to run: claude failed to run: spawnSync claude ETIMEDOUT
The opening proposes a layer without being asked: "I found 11 pairs... I suggest we start with **Title**".
It proposes only Title and names its 4 pairs; the only other pair named is Subtitle's Opacity, for 5 total, with the rest given as a count ("11 pairs... over 6 layers").
It names Old Take as hidden and Icon as a precomp, and for Icon says "I can't see inside it yet, so I can't tell you whether it's fine" rather than implying it's fine.

All names and times match the snapshot: 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased is 11 pairs, the 6 layers are Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take, Subtitle Opacity has linear_end "end", and Title's Position (0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s), Scale and Opacity (0.5–1.5 s) are correct.
It calls read_learner_record before snapshot_project, the record is empty (new learner), and the opening claims no earlier history.

The opening gives the count, the Title proposal and the leave-outs as one choice, explains nothing about easing, and ends on a single question about the layer: "Shall we start with Title, or would you rather pick another layer?"
